To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reference architecture RABIC is a comprehensive and holistic framework that provides a taxonomy for BI services and an architectural model for BI cloud systems, and that the reference architecture can be used to standardize, increase the transparency, abolish the skepticism, compare and assess BI cloud systems and BI cloud services.

RABIC, as a reference architecture for business Intelligence in the cloud, is the first attempt to provide a uniform description, classification and comparison for business intelligence cloud services and business intelligence cloud systems and to provide a uniform and comprehensive architectural framework for business intelligence cloud systems.
RABIC is an integral reference architecture that consists of a taxonomy and an architectural framework and supports the standardization, the increase the transparency and abolishes the skepticism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: How can a reference architecture for business Intelligence in the cloud be designed and implemented?
the question how BI cloud services can be described, how BI cloud systems can be assessed, and which architectural patterns are suitable.
the development of a reference architecture that is based on the integration of a taxonomy and an architectural framework.

the reference architecture for BI in the cloud (RABIC) has been successfully established.
